text.p: Italian forward Roberto Baggio said on Friday he had joined serie A side Bologna from AC Milan.
"I've chosen Bologna, a choice which gives me a lot of joy," he told a news conference. "From Sunday I'll be at the coach's service."

Bologna president Giuseppe Gazzoni Frascara, who was also at the specially convened conference, said Baggio had signed a two-year contract but suggested he would be free to leave after one season if he so wished.
"He's got a lot of freedom," said Gazzoni Frascara, who declined to give details of the transfer fee, reported by Italian newspapers to be around $3.0 million.
Baggio said last month he was leaving Milan after a frustrating season in which he was sidelined with sciatica and constantly left on the substitutes' bench even when he was fit.

Milan coach Fabio Capello had hinted there was no place for "the Divine Ponytail" in his plans for next season and the club said they were open to offers for arguably the greatest Italian player of his generation.
